#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string string_input;
    std::getline(std::cin, string_input);
    std::vector<char> output_list;
    bool has_at = true;

    for (size_t index = 0; index < string_input.length(); ++index) {
        char ch = string_input[index];

        if (index >= 2 && index < string_input.length() && 
            string_input.substr(index - 2, 3) == "dot") {
            if (!output_list.empty()) output_list.pop_back();
            if (output_list.size() >= 1) output_list.pop_back();
            output_list.push_back('.');
        } else if (index >= 1 && index + 1 < string_input.length() && 
                   string_input.substr(index - 1, 2) == "at" && has_at && index != 1 && index != string_input.length() - 1) {
            if (!output_list.empty()) output_list.pop_back();
            output_list.push_back('@');
            has_at = false;
        } else {
            output_list.push_back(ch);
        }
    }

    std::string final_string(output_list.begin(), output_list.end());
    std::cout << final_string << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
